scope: Evidence covers the official national DLRS map-search hierarchy, the official mauza/plot land-zoning viewer configuration, the Moulvibazar district administrative boundary endpoint, and official local land-office portals. Citywide parcel coverage and an anonymous parcel feature response were not verified.
schemaAndCrs: The map.land.gov.bd JavaScript configures OpenLayers in EPSG:4326 and references GeoServer WMS layers including wsDMMS:mouza, but no parcel feature schema or safe native-ID-bearing response was obtained. The settlement district boundary response is GeoJSON administrative geometry only.
nativeIdentity: Unavailable; no parcel feature response exposed a stable native parcel identifier.
retainedProperties: No GeoJSON sample retained because no unchanged native parcel polygon and stable native identity were obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if later exposed
unsafeDataPolicy: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, legal-description, or ownership fields were requested or retained. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
officialCustodyEvidence: The Moulvibazar district and upazila government portals provide local land-service evidence, while DLRS provides the official national map-search hierarchy and map services. General agency prose was not treated as local registry evidence.
limits: The Moulvibazar survey-list endpoint returned an empty array, so no downstream mouza/sheet/plot request was justified.
The configured GIS GeoServer returned HTTP 503 for WMS/WFS capabilities requests.
The available boundary response was an administrative district MultiPolygon, not a parcel polygon.
No exact-point hit or absence inference was made.
No parcel sample is retained and no source integration/admission is claimed.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial qualification of a real adapter.
uncertainty: The official viewers may expose parcel data for selected survey/mouza/sheet combinations when their data service is available, but this attempt did not obtain a Moulvibazar survey selection or anonymous feature response. Further research needs a working bounded response with safe native identity and geometry evidence.
